text: A song of ascents. [1]The Lord answered mewhen I called in my distress: [AA]
Lord, deliver my soul from lying lips,from a treacherous tongue. [AB]
What will he inflict on you,O treacherous tongue,and what more besides? [2]
A warrior's arrowssharpened with coals of brush wood! [3] [AC]
t[4]Alas, I am a foreigner in Meshech,I live among the tents of Kedar!
Too long do I liveamong those who hate peace.
When I speak of peace,they are for war. [AD]
